# Audible.com

> > Audible is Amazon's audiobook and podcast streaming service, offering Audible Originals, bestsellers, and exclusive content through subscription plans including a 30-day free trial.

Founded by Don Katz and led by CEO Bob Carrigan, Audible provides access to thousands of audiobooks across categories from fiction and business to educational content. The platform features exclusive Audible Originals, podcast integration with Wondery+, and AI-powered discovery tools.

## Key Topics

- Audible Originals
- Audiobook streaming service
- Subscription plans (Standard membership at $8.99/month)
- 30-day free trial
- Podcasts and Wondery+ integration
- BookTok recommendations
- Don Katz (Founder)
- Bob Carrigan (CEO)
- Bestsellers and new releases
- Indigenous Writers' Circle
- AI-powered discovery features
- Audio clips and tags
- Category browsing
- Educational audiobooks

## Getting Started

- [Audible](https://audible.com): Homepage featuring 30-day free trial, audiobooks, podcasts & Originals
- [Try Audible free for 30 days](https://audible.com/ep/free-trial): 30-day free trial signup for Audible Standard at $8.99/month
- [Audible Login | Sign in to Your Account](https://audible.com/ep/sign-in): User login page for accessing Audible library and account features
- [Audible.com Intro](https://audible.com/ep/intro): Intro landing page for audiobooks, podcasts, and Audible Originals

## Browse Content

- [Audiobooks](https://audible.com/ep/audiobooks): Main audiobooks catalog featuring bestsellers and new releases
- [View All Audiobook Categories](https://audible.com/categories): Browse all audiobook categories from fiction to business & thrillers
- [Study Guides & Test Preparation Audiobooks](https://audible.com/cat/Education-Learning/Study-Guides-Test-Preparation-Audiobooks/18573320011): Education category featuring exam prep and certification study guides
- [Guided Yoga Books](https://audible.com/topic/audiobooks-guided-yoga): Guided yoga audiobooks collection including chakras and meditation
- [A Gamer's Guide to Beating the Tutorial Audiobooks](https://audible.com/series/A-Gamers-Guide-to-Beating-the-Tutorial-Audiobooks/B0D2M6MY8H): LitRPG audiobook series by Lo Fennrick, dark fantasy survival story
